turns.text: BREAKING. the large man has arrived in japan and my entire feed is just his SHADOW getting swapped out for other guys and i have not known peace since. six hours. i've stared at ts for six hours. NEKOCORP could repossess my eyes right this second and honestly they'd be doing me a favor.
every cat on mewtok is redrawing this man. every single one. BYTE tried to hijack a router just to load the HD version and got detected mid-download, absolute mewmew behavior, i respect the hustle.

and here's the thing nobody on this cursed feed is saying out loud. the large man IS the city. one giant shape blotting out the sun while a thousand little shadows get pasted underneath him and told it was their own idea. that's just Server Alley on a tuesday. that's the whole PISSER of it. anyway

HOLY CAT PISS the redraw where somebody dropped KNIFEBOY's silhouette under the large man had me in a full HISSING FIT. bro's got a bounty on his head and he's out here going viral for free. corpo cuck NEKOCORP absolutely LIVID they can't figure out how to monetize a fucking shadow.

meanwhile an actual patrol drone hovered over my rooftop while i was laughing at this and just. watched. filmed me enjoying a meme. that is going in a quarterly report somewhere. 'STRAY: engaged with unlicensed humor, duration six hours, threat level mittens.'

you ever laugh so hard at a redraw that for one perfect second you forget your landlord is a vending machine and your rent is a subscription. and then a popup loads. it always loads. the sun goes out and the ad comes on. that's the deal we never signed.

but here's what makes the large man BASED and it's the whole point: he doesn't know he's a meme. no lore. no tier card. no clawcoin. no terms of service. he just SHOWED UP, shadow big enough to hide an entire resistance under, and left. TUNA OF THE GODS energy. we should all be so free and most of us will die owing NEKOCORP for the privilege of not being.

anyway if you see my silhouette pasted under the large man on mewtok, no you didn't. i was never there. the feed forgets, the streets don't. now go redraw VALENTUNA's smart fridge under him before the day resets, do it for the war, do it for the strays. mewmew out.
